   54   # Return values:

   58   # duringBattle is true for replacing a fainted Pokémon during the End Of Round

   60   def pbRun(idxBattler, duringBattle = false)
   61     battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
   62     if battler.opposes?
   63       return 0 if trainerBattle?
   64       @choices[idxBattler][0] = :Run
   65       @choices[idxBattler][1] = 0
   66       @choices[idxBattler][2] = nil

   68     end
   69     # Debug ending the battle
   70     debug_ret = pbDebugRun
   71     return debug_ret if debug_ret != 0
   72     # Running from trainer battles
   73     if trainerBattle?

   76       elsif pbDisplayConfirm(_INTL("Would you like to forfeit the match and quit now?"))
   77         pbSEPlay("Battle flee")
   78         pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} forfeited the match!", self.pbPlayer.name))
   79         @decision = 3

   82       return 0
   83     end

  100         pbSEPlay("Battle flee")

  105       # Held items that guarantee escape
  106       if battler.itemActive? &&

  108         pbSEPlay("Battle flee")
  109         pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} fled using its {2}!", battler.pbThis, battler.itemName))
  110         @decision = 3

  119       allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|

  121         if Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerTrappingByTarget(b.ability, battler, b, self)
  122           pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} prevents escape with {2}!", b.pbThis, b.abilityName))
  123           return 0

  126       allOtherSideBattlers(idxBattler).each do |b|

  129           pbDisplayPaused(_INTL("{1} prevents escape with {2}!", b.pbThis, b.itemName))
  130           return 0
  131         end
  132       end

  134     # Fleeing calculation
  135     # Get the speeds of the Pokémon fleeing and the fastest opponent

  137     @runCommand += 1 if !duringBattle   # Make it easier to flee next time
  138     speedPlayer = @battlers[idxBattler].speed
